reader_summary.headline: You may remember my popular first meeting from a few years ago with Paul Black of WCM.
reader_summary.overview: You may remember my popular first meeting from a few years ago with Paul Black of WCM, then a $25 billion asset manager in Laguna Beach. Since then, WCM has gone up and to the right in every way, they sold a minority piece of the business to Natixis. My guest on today's show is Mike Trigg.
